adoration.text: Adoration Room open daily 07:00–21:30; on public holidays 07:00–12:00.

confession.text: Available 30 minutes before all weekend Masses in the Main Church confession booth.

devotions.text: Nightly Zoom Rosary at 20:30, except Tuesdays. Divine Mercy devotion every Tuesday 20:00 in Main Church. Sacred Heart devotion every Friday after Mass in Main Church; online recordings linked at tinyurl.com/CTKClips.

office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00; Saturday–Sunday 09:00–13:00. Closed on public holidays.

good_to_know.text: Alight at Ang Mo Kio MRT; walk to bus stop toward Bishan (54339), then alight Opposite Christ the King Church (54319). Bus services listed: 22, 24, 50, 135, 159, 162, 162M, 262, 853, 853M.
Church gates close at noon on public holidays.
Adoration Room: remove shoes, maintain silence and reverence, do not touch the monstrance/statues or move fixtures, return cushions to storage.

events.title: Our Lady of the Rosary — Rosary Recitation
events.text: After 18:00 Mass; precise start time of recitation not stated.

events.title: KidZ Bible Camp — Come to the Table
events.text: 24–26 November 2026: Tuesday/Wednesday 08:30–13:00, Thursday 08:30–14:30. The poster says ages 4–12 and the website 4–6; check with the organisers. Families invited to Thanksgiving Mass and lunch on the final day. Enquiries: Belinda, Belkidzmatter@gmail.com.

public_holidays.text: Mass at 07:30 and 09:00; church gates close at 12:00 noon.

getting_there.text: Alight at Ang Mo Kio MRT; walk to bus stop toward Bishan (54339), then alight Opposite Christ the King Church (54319). Bus services listed: 22, 24, 50, 135, 159, 162, 162M, 262, 853, 853M.

languages.text: Mandarin: Sunday 08:30. Tamil: fourth Sunday 18:30. Other Masses are in English.

sacraments.text: Infant baptism first Sunday each month at 15:00; prior booking required and subject to availability. Parents and godparents must attend pre-baptism preparation. Use the Church Services enquiry form.

other.text: Free legal clinic for low-income individuals: last Tuesday monthly at 19:00. Collect registration form from Parish Office and submit at least five days ahead; strictly no walk-ins. The 27 October session is replaced by 24 November 2026.
Catholic Family Life pro-bono counselling: face-to-face at CTK Mondays 19:30 and 20:45; Zoom Monday–Saturday. Book at https://pbc.familylife.sg/ or 6631 8963.
First Sunday each month, every Mass includes prayers for birthdays, wedding anniversaries and expectant mothers.
